### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **16** documentable anchor(s).

**8** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx`  _(via runtimeFilter (literal, a string literal in sections))_

⛔ **10** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections), runtimeFilter (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **175** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 14f4d8f8cd997d3722db0460a0fc7230f793121a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ab38c306471fd583781eaa3cfac1ea13393e0563` — the merge of head `f2cbae0a02519de290478e4f85c8ed3c24156f7a` into base `14f4d8f8cd997d3722db0460a0fc7230f793121a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ab38c306471fd583781eaa3cfac1ea13393e0563 && git checkout ab38c306471fd583781eaa3cfac1ea13393e0563
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 14f4d8f8cd997d3722db0460a0fc7230f793121a f2cbae0a02519de290478e4f85c8ed3c24156f7a && git checkout -B drift-repro 14f4d8f8cd997d3722db0460a0fc7230f793121a && git merge --no-ff f2cbae0a02519de290478e4f85c8ed3c24156f7a

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 14f4d8f8cd997d3722db0460a0fc7230f793121a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 14f4d8f8cd997d3722db0460a0fc7230f793121a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f2cbae0a02519de290478e4f85c8ed3c24156f7a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts + packages/spec/src/ui/report-form-composite-children.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/report-dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.metadata-forms.generated.ts and zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts (agreement with the producer only), ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts

Inputs read: card #36447 body and all six comments (seat route in claim 7118706101, round-1 report 7119456005 with Q1-Q4, claim amendment 7119493070, round-2 report 7120587547); PR #36814 body and both comments; the net diff `origin/main...f2cbae0a`; the 73 check-runs on the head (every one `success` or `skipped`, none failed, none pending). The remainder of the diff (the other regenerated bundles and source-hashes, the five console test pins, the changeset prose) is the lane seat's ACCEPT.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set of `ReportSchema`: unchanged — right.** `report.zod.ts` moves six strings and nothing else: the `.meta({ title })` of `ReportSortSchema.by` (`Order By` to `Sort By`) and of `JoinedReportBlockSchema.dataset` / `rows` / `columns` / `values` / `order` (`Dataset` / `Rows` / `Columns` / `Values` / `Order` to `Data Source` / `Group By` / `Group Columns By` / `Metrics` / `Sort Order`). Every type, `.optional()`, `.default()`, `.describe()`, `strictObject` alias table and `superRefine` on those lines is byte-identical. No key added, removed or renamed; no value accepted or refused differently.
- **Authorable keys: unchanged — right.** The form now declares children for two composites. `dateRange` declares `dimension`, `defaultRange`, `allowCustomRange`; the schema block on main (`report.zod.ts`, the `dateRange` `strictObject`) declares exactly those three. `exportOptions` declares `formats`, `includeHeaders`, `fileNamePrefix`; `REPORT_EXPORT_OPTIONS_SHAPE` in `list-view-export-options.ts` declares exactly those three. A declared composite renders only its declared children, so the risk is a key dropping out of the panel, not a key appearing: none drops, and no row names a key the schema lacks. The rows declare no `type` or `widget`, so the controls stay schema-derived.
- **Public surface that does move: prose only — right.** (a) JSON Schema `title` of six item properties, served through `/api/v1/meta` and read by the repeater column headers and by the console's held-edit clauses (the moved pins `InterfacesPillar.reportHeld-27785`, `reportJoined-29022`, `metadataError.reportHeld-*` follow them). (b) The `metadataForms.report` catalog: 13 new leaves (`description.helpText`, and a `label` plus a `helpText` for each of the six children), and reworded English for existing leaves. No catalog key is removed or renamed; the two section keys slugged from their labels (`dataset_binding`, `joined_blocks`) keep their labels, as the seat route requires.
- **Form to schema title equality (the repeater-item-titles rule the form's own comment states): holds.** `order.by` `Sort By` equals `ReportSortSchema.by`; `blocks.dataset` / `rows` / `columns` / `values` / `order` equal the five `JoinedReportBlockSchema` titles; the untouched `Direction`, `Runtime Filter`, `Block Type` still match.
- **Ledger population arithmetic: consistent.** `report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts`: population 50 to 63, field leaves 40 to 53, section leaves stay 10, inward negatives 44 to 57 (63 minus the six decided rows). That is the 13 new leaves, and the en bundle diff shows exactly 13. `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`: 765 to 771, six row labels, which follows that control's established label-only count (every earlier step in its comment chain counts row labels).

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are correct, on the PR body and on the changeset body alike. Nothing a metadata author can write changes: no key, accepted value, default, requirement or meaning. AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3 gives `none` a `patch`, and the changeset carries `patch` for the three packages whose published text moves: `@objectstack/spec` (form prose and six titles), `@objectstack/platform-objects` (regenerated bundles), `@object-ui/app-shell` (the zh-CN overlay rows). No package that publishes moved text is missing from it. `Check Changeset` and `Spec property liveness` concluded `success` on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Seat route, Q1 A:** followed. Six ledger-pinned English sources are reworded and each ledger row's `en` moves with the form: three in `report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts` (`dataset_binding` description, `drilldown` hint, `runtimeFilter` hint) and three in `report-dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` (`dataset`, `values`, `rows` hints). All six rows carry the old English verbatim in their `reason` and say the zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES verdicts were taken against it and not re-judged. No decided row is deleted, no verdict changed, no translated value touched: no translation pin is silently dropped. The token-guard case that read the `runtimeFilter` row's `en` now holds the old sentence as a literal, with a comment saying why; the predicate it demonstrates is unchanged.
- **Q2 A:** followed. Children declared in `report.form.ts`, `description` given its own hint, completeness pin added; the shared `I18nLabel` describe and the list-view export describes are untouched.
- **Q3 A:** followed, form label and schema title together.
- **Q4 B:** followed. `dashboard.form.ts` is not in the diff.
- **Seat route prohibition (no rename of a section title whose key is slugged from its label):** held. `Dataset binding` and `Joined blocks` keep their labels and are listed as left over in the PR body. No `en` overlay was added.
- **Dev deviation "PR body not flipped":** resolved on the live body, which reads `Fixes #36447`.
- **Dev deviation "main merged for a conflict":** the lifecycle control stacks both reasons to 771; `Test Core` is green on the head.
- **Round-2 `open_questions`:** empty.
- **Out-of-scope finding without a carrier, for the seat:** the ja-JP and es-ES values of the six reworded rows still state the old developer meaning (true sentences, old vocabulary). The seat route accepted this under Q1 A; the dev noted it and filed nothing. It needs a translator-pass card from the seat, since the ledger rows now say in writing that they were not re-judged.
- **Out-of-scope finding, for the seat:** the Default Period select shows the stored preset (`this_month`) as option text in the inspector. It predates this diff; it needs its own card.
- **Open draft #36802** regenerates the same bundles; they are `merge=os-regen`, the later one regenerates.
- **SQL push-down:** not applicable. The diff adds no query, id materialisation or join.
- The PR is still a draft at the time of this record.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts`** — every new or reworded sentence read against the runtime on main:

- `description` hint "displayed under its name": `ReportViewer.tsx` draws `report.description` directly under the title. True. Same meaning as the zh-CN overlay row merged with #36420.
- `dataset` hint "everyone sees only the records they have access to": agrees with the `ReportSchema.dateRange` TSDoc ("what a viewer may read stays with the dataset object's access"). True.
- `rows`, `columns`, `order`, `drilldown`, `blocks`, `chart`, the three section descriptions: restate the old sentences in business words without adding a promise. `order` keeps its two facts (a grouping or a metric; time groupings chronological by default), both enforced or documented at `checkReportOrder` and the #3916 comment.
- `runtimeFilter` hint "on top of the data source's own conditions": `ReportDateRange.tsx` and the schema TSDoc both state the server ANDs `runtimeFilter` with the dataset's own filter. True.
- `dateRange.dimension`: the schema describe and `useReportDateDimension` use the dataset's one `type: 'date'` dimension when omitted. "Leave it empty when the data source has only one" is true.
- `dateRange.defaultRange` "The period the report opens with": `initialReportPeriod` does exactly that. True.
- `dateRange.allowCustomRange`: `ReportDateRangeControl` offers the custom pick unless it is `false`. True.
- `exportOptions.formats`: `readReportExportFormats` returns both formats when the list is absent and none for an empty list, and the control then draws nothing. True.
- `exportOptions.includeHeaders`: `buildReportCsv` / `buildReportXlsx` write the header row first when it is not `false`. True.
- `exportOptions.fileNamePrefix`: `buildExportFileName` takes the prefix ahead of the report label. True in substance (see N3).
- `exportOptions` composite hint: the export-permission sentence matches the schema TSDoc (`ObjectPermission.allowExport` on the dataset's base object).
- The English now carries the meaning of the zh-CN overlay rows of #36420 (data source, group, metric, sort), which is the card's acceptance line. The two left-over section titles are the route's own exception.

I tried to break it on three points and could not: a composite child list that drifts from the schema (pinned both ways by set equality in the new test, and the dev's ablation is recorded); a title rename that a consumer keys on (titles are display text only; every reader in the diff is a label pin, and no generated artifact in the tree stores them); a hint promising behaviour the engine lacks (each checked above).

**`packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts`** — six `title` strings, each equal to the form label of its row. The neighbouring TSDoc and `.describe()` sentences keep the author vocabulary (dimension, measure) and stay true; nothing in the file now contradicts itself.

**Implementing files, read for agreement:**

- `report-form-composite-children.test.ts`: derives the schema the way the inspector does, has a non-empty control, holds each declared list equal to the schema keys, and requires a label and a hint on every child. It agrees with the form comment that cites it. It states openly that hints are not held equal to the describes, which is the point of the rows.
- The two report echo-decision ledgers and the lifecycle control: agree with the producer, as set out in ① and ③.
- `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`: every leaf equals the form text. `zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts`: the seven new zh-CN values say what the English says.
- `metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`: the six new overlay rows are byte copies of the platform zh-CN bundle rows, as the file's own rule and the new comment say.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 — The top-level rows keep the prettified labels `Dataset` / `Values` / `Rows` / `Columns` while the same keys in the blocks grid now read `Data Source` / `Metrics` / `Group By` / `Group Columns By`, and the top-level hints already speak of the data source and metrics. The console panel does not draw the top-level rows, but the server-served form does and shows both vocabularies. Inside the route (Q3 named the block and sort titles only); a follow-up card or an accepted deviation.
- N2 — `values` hint "The metrics to total or count" is narrower than what a dataset measure can be (averages, ratios and other derived measures exist). The zh-CN row says "the metrics to compute". Wording only.
- N3 — `fileNamePrefix` hint says "used instead of the report name"; the runtime replaces the report label (and falls back to the name), while the form's own `Name` row is the machine name. Wording only.
- N4 — The console zh-CN overlay's `dateRange` hint still carries the date-grouping sentence the English moved onto the `Date Field` child, and its `runtimeFilter` hint still reads as render-time / AND wording, so on these two rows the English is now plainer than the Chinese. Belongs with the translator-pass follow-up in ③.

Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufziwMkZG34d69p8BHb4`

**VERDICT: PASS**

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: `f2cbae0a02519de290478e4f85c8ed3c24156f7a`
Card: #36447 (round 2) · claim 7118706101, amendment 7119493070 (seat route Q1–Q3 A, Q4 B) · os-dev-report 7120587547 (`Dev-effort: high`, `Rounds: 2`).
Contract review on this head: 7121019942 (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, **PASS**, `No must-fix, no should-fix.`, nits N1–N4; claim 7120958219).

### Checklist
- **Shape:** `l1-face` CLEAN. Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36447`, no closing keyword next to another card. Under the route, Q2-A keeps the composite rows in this card and Q4-B moves the dashboard widget form to a separate card. So this PR delivers the whole card as routed, and `Fixes` is right.
- **Checks at this head:** 73 check-runs. 61 success, 12 expected skip, 0 failed. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check: success; `check:generated` and the i18n bundle gates are green in CI. `mergeable_state` clean.
- **Governance:** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 36814`: NOT governed, 725 lines, most of them regenerated bundles.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` in the body and the changeset; they match the claim and its amendment. Contract review ② agrees: `report.zod.ts` moves six item `.meta({ title })` strings only, with types, defaults, describes, alias tables and refinements byte-identical. The six declared composite children equal the schema's keys on `main`, so no accept set and no authorable key changes.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/platform-objects` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, all at patch. Spec and platform-objects are published and their `src/**` moved; app-shell is private, so its line is inert. The prose, read sentence by sentence:
  - business terms replace the schema vocabulary in the report form: true;
  - every section description and hint drawn by the panel reworded: true;
  - six child rows with hints for the two composites: true, with the completeness pin `report-form-composite-children.test.ts`;
  - Description gets its own hint: true;
  - the six joined-block and sort titles match the item schema titles: true, form and `.meta` together;
  - "No key, accepted value or section title changed": true. The two slugged section titles are left alone per the route;
  - the bundles are regenerated, with zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES for the 13 new rows, and the console zh-CN overlay carries them: true (`metadata-form-zh-cn.ts` +6 rows, copied from the platform zh-CN bundle).
- **UI strings:** the new rows carry en (producer) and zh-CN (platform bundle and console overlay), plus ja-JP / es-ES and the other platform locales via `os-regen`. Contract review ④ checked each hint against the runtime on `main` (`ReportDateRange.tsx`, `ReportExport.tsx`, `export-filename.ts`, `ReportViewer.tsx`).
- **Ledgers:** the six moved hints carry their new `en` in both report echo-decision ledgers. Each keeps the old English and a "not re-judged" reason. Counts are consistent (50→63, 40→53, 44→57). The lifecycle ledger (765→771) is the merge-conflict stack with #35315, which the report declares.
- **Scope:** inside the amended surface, except four existing `ui/.../studio-design/*.test.ts(x)` pins that read the old labels, and `metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`, the zh-CN overlay rows for the new form rows. The report declares both ("Round 1 missed five UI pins …; round 2 moved them"). They are direct consequences, so I accept them. The claim's `File surface:` line should be amended to name them (area, paper). The added `import '@objectstack/lint'` / `'@objectstack/formula'` at collection time in two test files is what `check:test-source-alias` requires.
- **Tests:** real commands with output. platform-objects: 125 files, 2126 tests. spec: 192 files, 7209 tests. 35 UI reader files, 273 tests. The completeness-pin ablation (one row deleted) turned 1 red. `check:i18n-coverage` was NOT MEASURED locally; CI's i18n gates are green.

### Findings
Must-fix: none. Should-fix: none.

Nits (the contract review's), each with the route or a follow-up:
- **N1 (user-visible):** the top-level rows still read `Dataset` / `Values` / `Rows` / `Columns`, while the same keys in the blocks grid now read `Data Source` / `Metrics` / `Group By` / `Group Columns By`, so one form shows both vocabularies. This is inside the route (Q3 named block and sort titles only). **To the seat:** a follow-up card to align the top-level row labels.
- **N2:** the `values` hint "The metrics to total or count" is narrower than what a measure can be.
- **N3:** the `fileNamePrefix` hint says "instead of the report name"; the runtime replaces the report label, falling back to the name.
- **N4:** the console zh-CN overlay hints for `dateRange` and `runtimeFilter` trail the plainer English.

N2–N4 are wording and can ride with N1's card.

### For the seat (contract review ③, not findings on this diff)
- The ja-JP / es-ES values of the six reworded rows keep the old developer meaning. The route accepted that, but no carrier card exists: file a translator-pass card.
- The Default Period select shows raw preset values (`this_month`). This predates the diff and needs its own card.

### Landing notes
`Fixes #36447`: merging closes the card; `pm:dispatched` comes off at close-out. The area lands on this ACCEPT plus PASS 7121019942.
